subject.title: feat(ui): logo-scare lobster visits; drop the model-auth-expiring chip

question: Should the Control UI suppress the pre-expiry sidebar warning for every provider, or only for credential flows proven to refresh continuously?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes provider-health visibility rather than fixing an established implementation defect, and its OAuth-specific rationale does not determine the policy for static or failed-refresh credentials.

options.title: Preserve targeted warning coverage
options.body: Keep or narrow the expiring warning so credentials without reliable refresh behavior still guide users to Model Providers before hard expiry.

options.title: Approve global suppression
options.body: Accept that users see provider auth only once expired and document that the warning is intentionally removed for all providers.

recommendation.title: Preserve targeted warning coverage
recommendation.body: Keep or narrow the expiring warning so credentials without reliable refresh behavior still guide users to Model Providers before hard expiry.

likelyOwner.reason: The current UI policy change and supporting behavior are authored on this branch; ownership confidence remains low without a stronger current-main history trail.
